# Cargo workspaces outside the root workspace, which Bazel does not build, so
# `bazel test //crates/...` cannot run their tests. The rust_test job in
# .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml runs every test target of each one under
# cargo, with the root's pinned nightly, and reads libtest's record of each
# as it does a Bazel rust_test's. .github/sami/rust-test-parity.sh fails while
# a Cargo.toml outside the root workspace is missing here.
# One per line: <Cargo.toml path>  <why Bazel does not build it>.
sdk/rust/omp-rpc/Cargo.toml  standalone [workspace] (Cargo.toml:20), and .bazelignore leaves out sdk/
